blocks.zh: Section 4: Part II Glossary & Appendices — Key Terms and Illustrative Examples｜第二部分術語、附錄：對比方法與說明範例
blocks.en: Section 4: Part II Glossary & Appendices — Key Terms and Illustrative Examples

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 完整掌握 Part II 附件的全部官方術語定義（10 個核心術語）
blocks.en: Fully understand all official glossary definitions in the Part II annex (10 core terms)

blocks.zh: 透過 Appendix 1 的對比表，清楚區分「最小方法」與「QbD 增強方法」在六個面向的差異
blocks.en: Use the Appendix 1 comparison table to clearly distinguish the "minimal approach" from the "QbD enhanced approach" across six aspects

blocks.zh: 透過 Appendix 2 的說明範例，理解 Ishikawa/FMEA 風險評估工具的實際應用步驟
blocks.en: Use the Appendix 2 illustrative examples to understand how the Ishikawa/FMEA risk assessment tools are applied step by step

blocks.zh: 理解設計空間的三種圖形呈現方式（回應面圖、等高線圖、時間路徑 DS）
blocks.en: Understand the three ways of presenting a design space graphically (response surface plot, contour plot, time-path DS)

blocks.zh: 能夠解釋線性 DS 與非線性 DS 的差異及各自的實務考量
blocks.en: Be able to explain the difference between a linear DS and a non-linear DS and the practical considerations of each

blocks.zh: Part II 附件術語定義（Section 4: Glossary）｜全套核心術語
blocks.en: Part II Annex Glossary (Section 4: Glossary) — Complete Set of Core Terms

blocks.zh: 中文解析：核心術語深度對照
blocks.en: Commentary: In-Depth Review of Core Terms

blocks.zh: QbD 官方定義的三個關鍵元素
blocks.en: Three Key Elements of the Official QbD Definition

blocks.zh: Part II Glossary 提供了 QbD 的官方定義，有三個關鍵元素：
blocks.en: The Part II Glossary gives the official definition of QbD, which has three key elements:

blocks.zh: 「從預定目標開始」（begins with predefined objectives）：即從 QTPP 出發，而非從原料藥特性或製程開始
blocks.en: "Begins with predefined objectives": start from the QTPP, not from the drug substance properties or the process

blocks.zh: 「強調製品和製程理解」：科學理解是核心，而非單純的數據積累
blocks.en: "Emphasizes product and process understanding": scientific understanding is the core, not simply the accumulation of data

blocks.zh: 「基於紮實科學和 QRM」：QbD 不是獨立方法，而是與 Q9（QRM）和 Q10（PQS）整合使用
blocks.en: "Based on sound science and quality risk management": QbD is not a stand-alone method; it is used together with Q9 (QRM) and Q10 (PQS)

blocks.zh: CPP 的精確定義：影響 CQA 的才算
blocks.en: Precise Definition of a CPP: Only Parameters That Affect a CQA Qualify

blocks.zh: CPP 的定義非常精確：其變異影響 CQA 的製程參數。注意：
blocks.en: The definition of a CPP is very precise: a process parameter whose variability has an impact on a CQA. Note:

blocks.zh: 若某製程參數在正常操作範圍內的變異不影響任何 CQA，它就不是 CPP
blocks.en: If variation of a process parameter within its normal operating range does not affect any CQA, it is not a CPP

blocks.zh: CPP 的識別依賴風險評估（2.3）和 DoE 實驗確認
blocks.en: Identifying CPPs relies on risk assessment (2.3) and confirmation by DoE experiments

blocks.zh: CPP 列表需要監管申報，並在 3.2.P.3.3 和 3.2.P.3.4 中記錄
blocks.en: The CPP list must be submitted to the regulators and documented in 3.2.P.3.3 and 3.2.P.3.4

blocks.zh: 常見錯誤：將「需要控制的製程參數」全部稱為 CPP——只有確認對 CQA 有影響的才是 CPP。
blocks.en: Common mistake: calling every process parameter that needs to be controlled a CPP. Only those confirmed to affect a CQA are CPPs.

blocks.zh: PAR vs CPP 的關係
blocks.en: Relationship Between PAR and CPP

blocks.zh: PAR（Proven Acceptable Range）和 CPP 是不同層次的概念：
blocks.en: PAR (Proven Acceptable Range) and CPP are concepts at different levels:

blocks.zh: CPP = 「這個參數對品質有關鍵影響」（分類判斷）
blocks.en: CPP = "this parameter has a critical impact on quality" (a classification judgement)

blocks.zh: PAR = 「這個 CPP 的可接受操作範圍是多少」（範圍確定）
blocks.en: PAR = "what is the acceptable operating range of this CPP" (range determination)

blocks.zh: 邏輯鏈：識別 CPP → 通過實驗確定 PAR → 可考慮整合至 Design Space（如果做多變數分析）。
blocks.en: Logical chain: identify the CPP → determine the PAR through experiments → optionally integrate into the Design Space (if multivariate analysis is performed).

blocks.zh: Appendix 1: Differing Approaches to Pharmaceutical Development｜附錄一：不同開發方法的對比
blocks.en: Appendix 1: Differing Approaches to Pharmaceutical Development

blocks.zh: 中文解析
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 六個面向的核心差異解析
blocks.en: Analysis of the Core Differences Across the Six Aspects

blocks.zh: Appendix 1 是 Q8 中最直觀的 QbD 說明材料，六個對比維度揭示了「傳統方法」與「QbD 方法」的根本哲學差異：
blocks.en: Appendix 1 is the most intuitive explanatory material on QbD in Q8. Its six comparison dimensions reveal the fundamental philosophical difference between the "traditional approach" and the "QbD approach":

blocks.zh: 開發研究：單變數 OVAT（One Variable At a Time）→ 多變數 DoE（考慮交互作用）
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical development: single-variable OVAT (One Variable At a Time) → multivariate DoE (accounting for interactions)

blocks.zh: 製造製程：固定製程 → 設計空間內可調整
blocks.en: Manufacturing process: fixed process → adjustable within the design space

blocks.zh: 製程控制：離線終點判斷 → PAT inline 即時監控
blocks.en: Process control: offline end-point determination → inline real-time monitoring with PAT

blocks.zh: 產品規格：主要控制手段 → 整體控制策略的一部分
blocks.en: Product specification: the primary means of control → part of the overall control strategy

blocks.zh: 控制策略：事後測試 → 風險導向的上游控制
blocks.en: Control strategy: after-the-fact testing → risk-based upstream control

blocks.zh: 生命週期：被動反應（問題發生才處理）→ 主動預防 + 持續改善
blocks.en: Lifecycle management: reactive (act only when problems occur) → proactive prevention + continual improvement

blocks.zh: 實務考量：業界通常介於兩者之間
blocks.en: Practical Consideration: Industry Practice Usually Falls Between the Two

blocks.zh: Q8 明確指出：業界實際做法通常介於最小方法和完整 QbD 方法之間。這很重要——不需要全面實施 QbD 才能通過審查。許多公司採用「混合方法」：
blocks.en: Q8 states explicitly that actual industry practice usually falls between the minimal approach and the full QbD approach. This is important: you do not need to implement QbD in full to pass regulatory review. Many companies adopt a "hybrid approach":

blocks.zh: 部分 CQA 有完整的 Design Space（高風險/高不確定性的屬性）
blocks.en: Some CQAs have a full Design Space (attributes with high risk or high uncertainty)

blocks.zh: 其他 CQA 以傳統 PAR 控制
blocks.en: Other CQAs are controlled with a traditional PAR

blocks.zh: 某些單元操作採用 PAT，其他保持傳統 IPC
blocks.en: Some unit operations use PAT, while others retain traditional IPC

blocks.zh: 申請方應在提交文件中清楚說明其選擇的開發策略和程度。
blocks.en: The applicant should clearly explain the development strategy and the extent of development chosen in the submission.

blocks.zh: 從「固定製程」到「Design Space 內可調整」的典範轉移
blocks.en: A Paradigm Shift from a "Fixed Process" to "Adjustable Within the Design Space"

blocks.zh: 最重要的轉變是製造製程的定性：
blocks.en: The most important change is how the manufacturing process is characterized:

blocks.zh: Appendix 2: Illustrative Examples — Risk Assessment & Design Space Presentations｜附錄二：風險評估工具與設計空間呈現範例
blocks.en: Appendix 2: Illustrative Examples — Risk Assessment & Design Space Presentations

blocks.zh: A. Ishikawa + FMEA：風險評估的兩步驟
blocks.en: A. Ishikawa + FMEA: A Two-Step Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: Q8 Appendix 2A 說明的風險評估流程是業界標準方法：
blocks.en: The risk assessment flow described in Q8 Appendix 2A is an industry-standard method:

blocks.zh: 步驟 1：Ishikawa（魚骨圖）
blocks.en: Step 1: Ishikawa (fishbone diagram)

blocks.zh: ——腦力激盪，識別所有可能影響 CQA 的因素（廣撒網）
blocks.en: — brainstorm to identify all factors that could affect the CQA (cast a wide net)

blocks.zh: 六個主骨：原料、造粒、乾燥、壓錠、廠房因素、製程條件
blocks.en: Six main bones: raw materials, granulation, drying, compression, facility factors, process conditions

blocks.zh: 每個主骨下再細分具體參數（如：造粒 → 水量、噴霧速率、攪拌速率...）
blocks.en: Each main bone is then broken down into specific parameters (e.g., granulation → water amount, spray rate, mixing speed...)

blocks.zh: 步驟 2：FMEA 排序
blocks.en: Step 2: FMEA ranking

blocks.zh: ——對每個因素評分（收窄重點）
blocks.en: — score each factor (narrow the focus)

blocks.zh: Severity（嚴重性）：若發生失效，對患者/品質的影響有多嚴重？
blocks.en: Severity: if a failure occurs, how serious is the impact on the patient/quality?

blocks.zh: Probability（機率）：失效發生的可能性？
blocks.en: Probability: how likely is the failure to occur?

blocks.zh: Detectability（可偵測性）：失效能多快被發現？
blocks.en: Detectability: how quickly can the failure be detected?

blocks.zh: RPN（Risk Priority Number）= S × P × D → 排序後篩選高風險參數
blocks.en: RPN (Risk Priority Number) = S × P × D → rank and then select the high-risk parameters

blocks.zh: 步驟 3：DoE 確認——對高風險參數做實驗確認其真實影響
blocks.en: Step 3: DoE confirmation — run experiments on the high-risk parameters to confirm their true impact

blocks.zh: B. 交互作用的識別：平行線 vs 非平行線
blocks.en: B. Identifying Interactions: Parallel vs Non-Parallel Lines

blocks.zh: Appendix 2B 的核心教學：如何從二維交互圖判斷交互作用是否存在：
blocks.en: The core teaching point of Appendix 2B: how to tell from a two-dimensional interaction plot whether an interaction exists:

blocks.zh: 平行線（parallel lines） = 無交互作用 → 兩個參數可以獨立考量
blocks.en: Parallel lines = no interaction → the two parameters can be considered independently

blocks.zh: 非平行線（non-parallel） = 有交互作用 → 必須多維度一起考量
blocks.en: Non-parallel lines = interaction present → they must be considered together in multiple dimensions

blocks.zh: Q8 範例結論：IMC（初始水分）與溫度之間有交互作用——在高溫下，水分含量對降解產物 Y 的影響遠大於低溫。這正是「PAR 組合 ≠ Design Space」的原因：若只用單變數 PAR，會忽略這個危險的交互作用。
blocks.en: Conclusion of the Q8 example: there is an interaction between IMC (initial moisture content) and temperature. At high temperature, the effect of moisture content on degradation product Y is much greater than at low temperature. This is exactly why "a combination of PARs does not equal a Design Space": using only single-variable PARs would overlook this dangerous interaction.

blocks.zh: 類比：多 CQA 重疊 DS 如同投影重疊
blocks.en: Analogy: Overlapping DS for Multiple CQAs Is Like Overlapping Projections

blocks.zh: 想像用三個不同顏色的投影燈投射三個圓圈到牆上（每個圓代表一個 CQA 的可接受操作區域）。三個圓重疊的區域（交集）就是 Design Space——只有在這個區域內，所有三個 CQA 才能同時達到品質要求。
blocks.en: Imagine three projectors of different colors casting three circles on a wall (each circle represents the acceptable operating region for one CQA). The area where all three circles overlap (the intersection) is the Design Space: only within this area do all three CQAs meet their quality requirements at the same time.

blocks.zh: 這是 Q8 附錄 Example 2 的核心：DS 是同時滿足所有 CQA 的操作空間，不是滿足任何一個的操作空間。
blocks.en: This is the core of Example 2 in the Q8 appendix: the DS is the operating space that satisfies all CQAs at once, not the space that satisfies any single one.

blocks.zh: Example 3 凍乾設計空間的實務意義
blocks.en: Practical Significance of the Example 3 Lyophilization Design Space

blocks.zh: 凍乾（Lyophilization）製程的 DS 是一個典型的時間依存設計空間：
blocks.en: The DS of a lyophilization process is a typical time-dependent design space:

blocks.zh: 不是靜態的「溫度在 X-Y°C 之間」，而是「整個乾燥週期的溫度-時間路徑必須在一條走廊內」
blocks.en: It is not a static "temperature between X and Y °C", but rather "the temperature-time path over the whole drying cycle must stay within a corridor"

blocks.zh: 超過上限（溫度太高、時間太短）→ 過多降解產物
blocks.en: Above the upper limit (temperature too high, time too short) → excess degradation products

blocks.zh: 低於下限（溫度太低、時間太短）→ 過多粒子破碎（particle attrition）
blocks.en: Below the lower limit (temperature too low, time too short) → excess particle attrition

blocks.zh: 這種 DS 需要以方程式或軟件模型呈現，難以用簡單數值表達
blocks.en: This kind of DS needs to be presented as an equation or software model and is hard to express with simple numerical values

blocks.zh: 這種動態 DS 對生物製劑的凍乾工藝尤為重要——任何批次間的溫度曲線偏差都需要對照 DS 評估是否屬於「變更」。
blocks.en: This dynamic DS is especially important for lyophilization of biologics: any batch-to-batch deviation in the temperature profile must be assessed against the DS to decide whether it constitutes a "change".

blocks.zh: 綜合自我測試
blocks.en: Comprehensive Self-Test

blocks.zh: 用 FMEA 進行風險排序時，RPN（風險優先數）的三個組成部分是什麼？RPN 數值高代表什麼？
blocks.en: When ranking risks with FMEA, what are the three components of the RPN (risk priority number)? What does a high RPN value indicate?

blocks.zh: 在 Appendix 2B 的三個製程參數（IMC、溫度、粒徑）中，哪兩個有交互作用？如何從圖形判斷？
blocks.en: Among the three process parameters in Appendix 2B (IMC, temperature, particle size), which two interact? How can you tell from the plot?

blocks.zh: 一個製劑同時有「溶出 >80%」和「脆碎度 <2%」兩個 CQA 要求，如何確定其 Design Space？
blocks.en: A formulation has two CQA requirements: "dissolution >80%" and "friability <2%". How do you determine its Design Space?

blocks.zh: 為什麼凍乾製程的設計空間需要用時間路徑函數來描述，而不是簡單的溫度範圍？
blocks.en: Why does the design space of a lyophilization process need to be described with a time-path function rather than a simple temperature range?

blocks.zh: 申請方選擇用線性 DS（而非更大的非線性 DS）的實際理由是什麼？
blocks.en: What are the practical reasons for an applicant to choose a linear DS (rather than a larger non-linear DS)?

blocks.zh: ICH Q8(R2) 全文學習總結 — Complete Document Summary
blocks.en: Summary of the Complete ICH Q8(R2) Document

blocks.zh: 核心哲學：Quality built in by design, not tested into products — 品質源於設計，而非終點測試
blocks.en: Core philosophy: Quality built in by design, not tested into products

blocks.zh: Part I 架構：CTD 3.2.P.2 的最低要求框架；涵蓋 DS、CQA、CPP、配方開發、製程開發、容器封閉、微生物屬性、相容性
blocks.en: Part I structure: the minimum requirement framework of CTD 3.2.P.2; covers DS, CQA, CPP, formulation development, process development, container closure system, microbiological attributes, and compatibility

blocks.zh: Part II Annex：QbD 的操作化指南；最小要素（QTPP+CQA+製程+控制策略）+ 增強方法（Design Space + RTRT）
blocks.en: Part II Annex: operational guidance on QbD; minimal elements (QTPP + CQA + process + control strategy) + enhanced approach (Design Space + RTRT)

blocks.zh: 設計空間的法規意義：在 DS 內操作不算監管變更 → 製造彈性的科學基礎；DS ≠ PAR 組合（必須考慮多維交互作用）
blocks.en: Regulatory significance of the design space: operating within the DS is not considered a regulatory change, which is the scientific basis for manufacturing flexibility; DS ≠ a combination of PARs (multidimensional interactions must be considered)

blocks.zh: 術語精確性：QTPP（願景）→ CQA（屬性識別）→ CPP（製程識別）→ Design Space（多維空間）→ Control Strategy（控制落實）→ CPV（持續驗證）
blocks.en: Terminology precision: QTPP (the vision) → CQA (attribute identification) → CPP (process identification) → Design Space (multidimensional space) → Control Strategy (implementation of control) → CPV (continued process verification)

blocks.zh: 兩種方法均合法：最小方法和 QbD 增強方法均可通過監管審查；選擇 QbD 可獲得更大製造彈性作為回報
blocks.en: Both approaches are valid: the minimal approach and the enhanced QbD approach can both pass regulatory review; choosing QbD earns greater manufacturing flexibility in return

blocks.zh: Appendix 2 的工具應用：Ishikawa → FMEA → DoE → 交互作用分析 → Design Space 建立，是業界最廣泛採用的 QbD 實施路徑
blocks.en: Application of the Appendix 2 tools: Ishikawa → FMEA → DoE → interaction analysis → Design Space establishment is the most widely adopted QbD implementation path in industry
